card.name: Get/keep verbs in health advice
card.fires_on: Verbs like get, getting, keep and stay in advice sentences that tell readers to take a health action, such as getting screened or vaccinated or keeping children safe. Also fires on a few odd spots, such as 'WELL' before 'VERSED'.

modes.description: The verb get or getting begins a recommended health step.
